templates.name: D single scene, word or label + arrow to object
F series key art, logo lockup

constants: Overlay text is upper case on 20 of 20 (in-scene signs excluded).
Headline is a heavy or bold sans on every thumb; no serif, no script.
No fixed colour pair. Text colour splits: yellow 7, white 9, red 3, gold 1. Yellow or red is the accent on 10 of 20.
Text sits straight on the photo with a shadow or outline; one solid box in 20 (03, HORRIFYING tag).
Base is a real photograph on 16 of 20; composite, illustration or CGI-looking on 4 (04, 05, 10, 15).
No outline, glow or rim light on any person. No cut-out presenter.

host_treatment.host_face_share: 0 of 20 show an on-camera host portrait
host_treatment.treatment_where_present: Face 6 to 16% of frame width. Placed bottom or side. Head-and-shoulders or waist-up. Inside the photo, not cut out. Gaze: at an object in frame on 4 of 7 (07, 11, 12, 16); away on 1 (17); at camera on 1 (13); mixed on 1 (20).

text_rules.usual_word_count: 1 to 5 words on 16 of 20; longest 11 (10) and 9 (13).
text_rules.position: Top-centre 9, top-per-panel 6, top-left 2, centre 1, left-centre 1, bottom-right 1.
text_rules.highlight: Whole line in one colour on 6 (01, 05, 08, 14, 15, 20). One word in yellow with arrow on 12 and 17. Arrow to the object on 8 thumbs (03, 04, 07, 11, 12, 16, 17, 18).

popular_vs_latest.yellow_text: Popular (01 to 10): 1 of 10. Latest (11 to 20): 6 of 10.
popular_vs_latest.views: Popular 1.8M to 5.0M. Latest 20k to 626k; 19 has no view count in meta.
popular_vs_latest.caveat: Popular set is older and larger. Not a controlled comparison; the thumbs cannot be credited alone for the view gap.

top3.shared: Real archival photograph as the full frame (all 3). Short all-caps label (1 to 7 words). Zero faces on all 3. One dramatic object per frame: lightning house, blast, siren with tornado. Light text on dark or bright photo, high contrast.

transfer: Use one real archival or real photograph as the full frame. Evidence: 01, 02, 03 (top 3) are single archival frames; 16 of 20 are real photographs. Skip the CGI look (05, 15 are weakest on realism).

Headline: 1 to 3 words, all caps, top-centre, black drop shadow. Yellow for mystery claims, red for deaths or danger. Evidence: 01 yellow SATAN'S STORM; 14 red 39 PEOPLE DIED (626k); 05 red THE JOPLIN EF5.
One word plus a yellow arrow on the object that carries the threat. Evidence: 12 DEADLY to the car; 17 TORNADO to the horizon funnel; 18 NUCLEAR to the cloud; 07 TERRIFYING to the sign.
For list titles, three equal panels with one short label each. Evidence: 02 (4.3M), 04 (3.7M), 11 (443k), 19 (views unknown).

If the host is on camera, keep the face 9 to 16% of frame width, waist up, looking at an object, no outline. Evidence: 11 face 16% looking at the meteor; 12 face 9% looking at the car; 07 face 9% looking at the sign.

weak.why: Series brand card. Title repeated, 9 words in 3 lines, small type on dark key art, no question or stake. 20k views.
Three colour words over tinted photos, no subject or stake; the image reads as a data strip. View count null in meta, so judged on the image only.
CGI-looking orb and car with a name-only headline (VAL JOHNSON INCIDENT); a viewer who does not know the name gets no hook. 114k views.
